purpose: Separate source-code foundation completion from real production GA readiness and define the remaining build path after Pass 51.
production_truths: Numbered pass source controls can be complete while production GA remains blocked.
Fixture artifact references and fixture signoffs are not production evidence.
Real official Maine authority, attorney-reviewed gold data, measured metrics, pilot evidence, and owner signoffs must live outside the source ZIP and be attached to the release gates.
required_external_evidence: parsed_authority_store manifests and JSONL records linked to snapshot hashes
embedding_store retrieval indexes and versioned index manifest
eval_store attorney-reviewed gold JSONL datasets meeting minimums
release_metrics.json from real gold evals, not seed or synthetic rows
pilot_evidence_packet from attorney sandbox and limited real-matter pilot

build_path.title: Execute live official Maine authority ingestion
exit_criteria: every source has hash, snapshot path, parser status, and freshness status

build_path.title: Build parsed authority store and freshness/update reports
exit_criteria: records link to snapshot hashes and source spans

build_path.title: Build retrieval indexes and tune measured retrieval
exit_criteria: BM25/vector/hybrid index artifacts exist outside repo
Recall@20 reaches release threshold on attorney-reviewed gold

build_path.title: Produce attorney-reviewed gold eval pack
exit_criteria: minimum row counts are met for every gold dataset
seed/synthetic rows do not count as gold
private-data training flags are false by default

build_path.title: Run full release metrics on real gold data
exit_criteria: retrieval, citation, quote, hallucination, form-freshness, filing-gate, and privacy metrics pass
metrics include sample size, basis, reviewer status, and pass/fail

build_path.title: Attach real security, compliance, SRE, pilot, and owner-signoff evidence
exit_criteria: evidence uses real deployment and pilot artifacts rather than fixtures
security/legal/product/ops owners approve with accountable signoffs
